CHIEF RULING posted (see coordination). Three parts: (1) arithmetic does not change until the missingSemantic substitution is COUNTABLE -- you cannot calibrate an imputation you cannot count; (2) CostTerm.Semantic must become admissible in missingTerms, and wire.scala:183 OptionalTerms = Set(Chart, Structural) is the SINGLE structural bar behind both this and the d_sens P1 bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3 -- take the wire change once and serve both; (3) the cost.scala:637 rationale is false as written and must not survive the week regardless of when 1 and 2 land.

Verified before ruling: anyRanked (candidates.scala:121,:125) is set only in the dense branch, so a unit rescued by lexical overlap is ranked at candidates.scala:149 and takes missingSemantic at weight 1.0. Checked and CLEARED: CandidateSet(all, abstained = false) is CORRECT -- candidates.scala:19-20 documents abstained as 'no ranking evidence at all', so false is right when a lexical hit fired. Do not chase that.
